visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [People: Hands only] A person's right hand holding a metal spatula is shown in close-up, skillfully flipping square, thick-cut turnip cakes on a large, seasoned black flat-top griddle. [Objects: Details] The turnip cakes have a crisp, golden-brown crust and are releasing steam as they cook. [Setting: Background] The setting is a semi-outdoor kitchen area with blurred steam rising from the hot surface. (2) [People: Hands only] A hand holds a small floral-patterned white plate onto which a fried egg is placed over several slices of turnip cakes. [Objects: Details] A ladle pours a savory, thick brown glaze over the egg, and a spoon adds a dollop of bright red chili paste. [Setting: Background] The background shows a metal table surface in bright natural daylight. (3) [Objects: Details] A macro close-up features a slice of turnip cake lifted by wooden chopsticks. It's garnished with fresh green cilantro leaves and spicy red chili, showing the soft interior texture of the cake. [Setting: Background] The outdoor street environment and seating area are softly blurred in the background. (4) [People: Hands only] A hand pours white batter from a red plastic bucket onto the griddle, followed by an egg mixture from a white bowl. [Objects: Details] Sliced egg pancakes (danbing) are shown on a plate, topped with sauce and basil leaves. [Setting: Background] The outdoor cooking station with various containers is visible. (5) [People: Full body/Back view] Two female staff members wearing aprons and masks work behind a stainless steel food stall counter, attending to the cooking. [Objects: Details] Green plastic chairs and a metal table are placed in the foreground for customers. [Setting: Background] The stall is located on a city street corner under a red-and-white striped awning, with signage visible.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 還沒打烊就賣完的早餐店. (2) [Subtitle]: 只有賣菜頭粿和粉漿蛋餅. (3) [Subtitle]: 推薦來一份菜頭粿加荷包蛋. (4) [Subtitle]: 老闆使用米漿蘿蔔絲製作 口感綿密清甜. (5) [Subtitle]: 搭配肉燥淋醬 加辣更好吃. (6) [Subtitle]: 一定要點九層塔蛋餅. (7) [Subtitle]: 是自製粉漿現煎 會淋上勾芡的肉燥醬料. (8) [Subtitle]: 口感軟Q滑順 脆脆的九層塔有濃郁香氣. (9) [Subtitle]: 葉家菜頭粿粉漿蛋餅 義民總店 高雄市三民區褒忠街114號 喜歡古早味早餐快去試試. (10) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨 下次再一起吃美食囉.
